name: Truncated Depth-Based Sampling
definition: A ray sampling strategy that utilizes monocular depth priors informed by the truncated normal distribution to optimize ray point sampling, improving convergence speed and accuracy of pose estimation.
summary: Truncated Depth-Based Sampling is a ray sampling strategy that uses monocular depth priors to bias samples toward geometrically plausible regions via a truncated normal distribution, improving convergence and pose estimation accuracy.
